verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כִּי־ יָשַׁ֥ב הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּבֵית֑וֹ וַיהוָ֛ה הֵנִֽיחַ־ ל֥וֹ מִסָּבִ֖יב מִכָּל־ אֹיְבָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî- yā·šaḇ ham·me·leḵ bə·ḇê·ṯōw Yah·weh hê·nî·aḥ- lōw mis·sā·ḇîḇ mik·kāl ’ō·yə·ḇāw
verses.literal: After . . . the king had settled into his palace and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies around him
verses.literalPt: Estando já o rei de assento na sua casa, e tendo-lhe Jeová dado descanso de todos os seus inimigos ao redor,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֶל־ נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֔יא רְאֵ֣ה נָ֔א אָנֹכִ֥י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּבֵ֣ית אֲרָזִ֑ים וַֽאֲרוֹן֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים יֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיְרִיעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’el- nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî rə·’êh nā ’ā·nō·ḵî yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ḇêṯ ’ă·rā·zîm wa·’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yō·šêḇ bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·rî·‘āh
verses.literal: he said to Nathan the prophet Here . . . I am living in a house of cedar while the ark of God remains in a tent
verses.literalPt: disse ele ao profeta Natã: Eis que eu estou morando numa casa de cedro, e a arca de Deus, dentro de cortinas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר נָתָן֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֖ לֵ֣ךְ עֲשֵׂ֑ה כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer nā·ṯān ’el- ham·me·leḵ kōl ’ă·šer bil·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā lêḵ ‘ă·śêh kî Yah·weh ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: And Nathan . . . replied to the king Go and do all that is in your heart for the LORD is with you
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Natã ao rei: Vai e faze tudo o que tens no teu coração, porque Jeová é contigo.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֑וּא וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ נָתָ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bal·lay·lāh ha·hū way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- nā·ṯān lê·mōr
verses.literal: But that . . . night the word of the LORD came to Nathan saying
verses.literalPt: Mas, naquela mesma noite, veio a palavra de Jeová a Natã, dizendo:

verses.original: לֵ֤ךְ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ אֶל־ עַבְדִּ֣י אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הַאַתָּ֛ה תִּבְנֶה־ לִּ֥י בַ֖יִת לְשִׁבְתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ wə·’ā·mar·tā ’el- ‘aḇ·dî ’el- dā·wiḏ kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ha·’at·tāh tiḇ·neh- lî ḇa·yiṯ lə·šiḇ·tî
verses.literal: Go and tell My servant . . . David that this is what the LORD says Are you the one to build for Me a house to dwell in
verses.literalPt: Vai dizer ao meu servo Davi: Assim diz Jeová: Edificar-me-ás tu uma casa em que eu habite?

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשַׁ֙בְתִּי֙ בְּבַ֔יִת לְ֠מִיּוֹם הַעֲלֹתִ֞י אֶת־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָאֶֽהְיֶה֙ מִתְהַלֵּ֔ךְ בְּאֹ֖הֶל וּבְמִשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō yā·šaḇ·tî bə·ḇa·yiṯ lə·mî·yō·wm ha·‘ă·lō·ṯî ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mim·miṣ·ra·yim wə·‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh wā·’eh·yeh miṯ·hal·lêḵ bə·’ō·hel ū·ḇə·miš·kān
verses.literal: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought the Israelites up . . . out of Egypt until this day but I have moved about with a tent as My dwelling
verses.literalPt: Desde o dia em que eu fiz subir os filhos de Israel do Egito até hoje, não tenho habitado em casa nenhuma, mas tenho peregrinado em tenda e em tabernáculo.

verses.original: בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־ הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֮ בְּכָל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ הֲדָבָ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי אֶת־ אַחַד֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֗יתִי לִרְע֛וֹת אֶת־ עַמִּ֥י אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֛מָּה לֹֽא־ בְנִיתֶ֥ם לִ֖י בֵּ֥ית אֲרָזִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- hiṯ·hal·laḵ·tî bə·ḵāl bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hă·ḏā·ḇār dib·bar·tî ’eṯ- ’a·ḥaḏ šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî lir·‘ō·wṯ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr lām·māh lō- ḇə·nî·ṯem lî bêṯ ’ă·rā·zîm
verses.literal: In all My journeys with all the Israelites . . . have I ever asked . . . . . . any of the leaders - I appointed to shepherd My people Israel . . . Why haven’t you built Me a house of cedar
verses.literalPt: Em todos os lugares em que tenho peregrinado com todos os filhos de Israel, falei jamais palavra a alguma das suas tribos, a que mandei que apascentasse o meu povo de Israel, dizendo: Por que me não tendes edificado uma casa de cedro?

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּה כֹּֽה־ תֹאמַ֞ר לְעַבְדִּ֣י לְדָוִ֗ד כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲנִ֤י לְקַחְתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִן־ הַנָּוֶ֔ה מֵאַחַ֖ר הַצֹּ֑אן לִֽהְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַל־ עַמִּ֖י עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh kōh- ṯō·mar lə·‘aḇ·dî lə·ḏā·wiḏ kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ă·nî lə·qaḥ·tî·ḵā min- han·nā·weh mê·’a·ḥar haṣ·ṣōn lih·yō·wṯ nā·ḡîḏ ‘al- ‘am·mî ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now then you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says I took you from the pasture from following the flock to be the ruler over My people . . . Israel
verses.literalPt: Agora, assim dirás ao meu servo Davi: Assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos: Eu te tirei da malhada, de detrás das ovelhas, para que fosses príncipe sobre o meu povo, sobre Israel;

verses.original: וָאֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמְּךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֔כְתָּ וָאַכְרִ֥תָה אֶת־ כָּל־ אֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וְעָשִׂ֤תִֽי לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֣ם גָּד֔וֹל כְּשֵׁ֥ם הַגְּדֹלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eh·yeh ‘im·mə·ḵā bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer hā·laḵ·tā wā·’aḵ·ri·ṯāh ’eṯ- kāl- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā mip·pā·ne·ḵā wə·‘ā·śi·ṯî lə·ḵā šêm gā·ḏō·wl kə·šêm hag·gə·ḏō·lîm ’ă·šer bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: I have been with you wherever you have gone and I have cut off all your enemies from before you Now I will make for you a name like that of . . . the greatest in the land
verses.literalPt: por onde quer que andaste, tenho estado contigo para exterminar os teus inimigos de diante de ti; e te farei um grande nome como o dos grandes que há na terra.

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י מָ֠קוֹם לְעַמִּ֨י לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּנְטַעְתִּיו֙ וְשָׁכַ֣ן תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְלֹ֥א יִרְגַּ֖ז ע֑וֹד וְלֹֽא־ יֹסִ֤יפוּ בְנֵֽי־ עַוְלָה֙ לְעַנּוֹת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî mā·qō·wm lə·‘am·mî lə·yiś·rā·’êl ū·nə·ṭa‘·tîw wə·šā·ḵan taḥ·tāw wə·lō yir·gaz ‘ō·wḏ wə·lō- yō·sî·p̄ū ḇə·nê- ‘aw·lāh lə·‘an·nō·w·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer bā·ri·šō·w·nāh
verses.literal: And I will provide a place for My people Israel and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own and be disturbed no more No longer will the sons of wickedness oppress them as they did at the beginning
verses.literalPt: Designarei um lugar para o meu povo, para Israel, e o plantarei, e habitará no seu lugar; não mais será perturbado, nem os filhos da iniquidade tornarão a afligi-lo como dantes

verses.original: וּלְמִן־ הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֤יתִי שֹֽׁפְטִים֙ עַל־ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַהֲנִיחֹ֥תִי לְךָ֖ מִכָּל־ אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וְהִגִּ֤יד לְךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה כִּי־ בַ֖יִת יַעֲשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֥ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî šō·p̄ə·ṭîm ‘al- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl wa·hă·nî·ḥō·ṯî lə·ḵā mik·kāl ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā wə·hig·gîḏ lə·ḵā Yah·weh kî- ḇa·yiṯ ya·‘ă·śeh- lə·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: and have done since the day I appointed judges over My people Israel I will give you rest . . . from all your enemies The LORD . . . declares to you that He Himself will establish a house for you
verses.literalPt: e como desde o dia em que mandei que houvesse juízes sobre o meu povo de Israel. Dar-te-ei descanso de todos os teus inimigos. Também Jeová te diz que ele mesmo te fará uma casa.

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ יִמְלְא֣וּ יָמֶ֗יךָ וְשָֽׁכַבְתָּ֙ אֶת־ אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ וַהֲקִימֹתִ֤י אֶֽת־ זַרְעֲךָ֙ אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵצֵ֖א מִמֵּעֶ֑יךָ וַהֲכִינֹתִ֖י אֶת־ מַמְלַכְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî yim·lə·’ū yā·me·ḵā wə·šā·ḵaḇ·tā ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā wa·hă·qî·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- zar·‘ă·ḵā ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā ’ă·šer yê·ṣê mim·mê·‘e·ḵā wa·hă·ḵî·nō·ṯî ’eṯ- mam·laḵ·tōw
verses.literal: And when your days are fulfilled and you rest with your fathers I will raise up your descendant after you who will come from your own body and I will establish his kingdom
verses.literalPt: Completos que forem os teus dias, e vieres a dormir com teus pais, suscitarei depois de ti a tua semente, que procederá das tuas entranhas, e estabelecerei o seu reino.

verses.original: ה֥וּא יִבְנֶה־ בַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִ֑י וְכֹנַנְתִּ֛י אֶת־ כִּסֵּ֥א מַמְלַכְתּ֖וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hū yiḇ·neh- ba·yiṯ liš·mî wə·ḵō·nan·tî ’eṯ- kis·sê mam·laḵ·tōw ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He will build a house for My Name and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Ele edificará uma casa para o meu nome, e eu estabelecerei para sempre o trono do seu reino.

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ אֶהְיֶה־ לּ֣וֹ לְאָ֔ב וְה֖וּא יִהְיֶה־ לִּ֣י לְבֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּהַ֣עֲוֺת֔וֹ וְהֹֽכַחְתִּיו֙ בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וּבְנִגְעֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’eh·yeh- lōw lə·’āḇ wə·hū yih·yeh- lî lə·ḇên ’ă·šer bə·ha·‘ă·wō·ṯōw wə·hō·ḵaḥ·tîw bə·šê·ḇeṭ ’ă·nā·šîm ū·ḇə·niḡ·‘ê bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: I will be his Father and he will be My son When he does wrong I will discipline him with the rod of men and with the blows of the sons of men
verses.literalPt: Eu lhe serei pai, e ele me será filho. Se ele cometer iniquidade, castigá-lo-ei com varas de homens, e com açoites de filhos de homens;

verses.original: וְחַסְדִּ֖י לֹא־ יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֲסִרֹ֙תִי֙ מֵעִ֣ם שָׁא֔וּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲסִרֹ֖תִי מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥas·dî lō- yā·sūr mim·men·nū ka·’ă·šer hă·si·rō·ṯî mê·‘im šā·’ūl ’ă·šer hă·si·rō·ṯî mil·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: But My loving devotion will never be removed from him as I removed it from . . . Saul whom I removed from before you
verses.literalPt: porém a minha misericórdia não se retirará dele, como a retirei de Saul, a quem tirei de diante de ti.

verses.original: וְנֶאְמַ֨ן בֵּיתְךָ֧ וּמַֽמְלַכְתְּךָ֛ עַד־ עוֹלָ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כִּֽסְאֲךָ֔ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ne’·man bê·ṯə·ḵā ū·mam·laḵ·tə·ḵā ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kis·’ă·ḵā yih·yeh nā·ḵō·wn ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Your house and kingdom will endure forever before Me and your throne will be established forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Será estável para sempre diante de mim a tua casa e o teu reino; será estabelecido para sempre o teu trono.

verses.original: כְּכֹל֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וּכְכֹ֖ל הַחִזָּי֣וֹן הַזֶּ֑ה כֵּ֛ן דִּבֶּ֥ר נָתָ֖ן אֶל־ דָּוִֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·ḵōl had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ū·ḵə·ḵōl ha·ḥiz·zā·yō·wn haz·zeh kên dib·ber nā·ṯān ’el- dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire revelation
verses.literalPt: Segundo todas estas palavras e segundo toda esta visão, assim falou Natã a Davi.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔ד וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מִ֣י אָנֹכִ֞י אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ וּמִ֣י בֵיתִ֔י כִּ֥י הֲבִיאֹתַ֖נִי עַד־ הֲלֹֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ way·yê·šeḇ lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yō·mer mî ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ū·mî ḇê·ṯî kî hă·ḇî·’ō·ṯa·nî ‘aḏ- hă·lōm
verses.literal: Then King David went in sat before the LORD and said Who am I O Lord GOD and what is my house that You have brought me this far
verses.literalPt: Entrou o rei Davi, e sentou-se diante de Jeová, e disse: Quem sou eu, Senhor Jeová, e que casa é a minha, para que me tenhas trazido até aqui?

verses.original: וַתִּקְטַן֩ ע֨וֹד זֹ֤את בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וַתְּדַבֵּ֛ר גַּ֥ם אֶל־ בֵּֽית־ עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְמֵֽרָח֑וֹק וְזֹ֛את תּוֹרַ֥ת הָאָדָ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·ṭan ‘ō·wḏ zōṯ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wat·tə·ḏab·bêr gam ’el- bêṯ- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā lə·mê·rā·ḥō·wq wə·zōṯ tō·w·raṯ hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes O Lord GOD You have also spoken about the future of the house of Your servant Is this Your custom with man O Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Isso ainda foi pouco aos teus olhos, Senhor Jeová; mas falaste a respeito da casa do teu servo para tempos distantes. É esta a lei de homens, Senhor Jeová?

verses.original: וּמַה־ יּוֹסִ֥יף דָּוִ֛ד ע֖וֹד לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְאַתָּ֛ה יָדַ֥עְתָּ אֶֽת־ עַבְדְּךָ֖ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mah- yō·w·sîp̄ dā·wiḏ ‘ō·wḏ lə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·le·ḵā wə·’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: What more . . . can David say to You For You know Your servant O Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Que mais te poderá dizer Davi? Pois tu, Senhor Jeová, conheces o teu servo.

verses.original: בַּעֲב֤וּר דְּבָֽרְךָ֙ וּֽכְלִבְּךָ֔ עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַגְּדוּלָּ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את לְהוֹדִ֖יעַ אֶת־ עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·ḇūr də·ḇā·rə·ḵā ū·ḵə·lib·bə·ḵā ‘ā·śî·ṯā ’êṯ kāl- hag·gə·ḏūl·lāh haz·zōṯ lə·hō·w·ḏî·a‘ ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: For the sake of Your word and according to Your own heart You have accomplished this great thing and revealed it to Your servant
verses.literalPt: Por causa da tua palavra e segundo o teu coração, fizeste toda essa grandeza, dando-a a conhecer ao teu servo.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֥ן גָּדַ֖לְתָּ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כִּֽי־ אֵ֣ין כָּמ֗וֹךָ וְאֵ֤ין אֱלֹהִים֙ זֽוּלָתֶ֔ךָ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּאָזְנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên gā·ḏal·tā ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kî- ’ên kā·mō·w·ḵā wə·’ên ’ĕ·lō·hîm zū·lā·ṯe·ḵā bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- šā·ma‘·nū bə·’ā·zə·nê·nū
verses.literal: How . . . great You are O Lord GOD For there is none like You and there is no God but You according to everything we have heard with our own ears
verses.literalPt: Pelo que tu és grande, Deus Jeová, pois ninguém há semelhante a ti, e não há outro Deus fora de ti, segundo tudo o que temos ouvido com os nossos ouvidos.

verses.original: וּמִ֤י כְעַמְּךָ֙ כְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גּ֥וֹי אֶחָ֖ד בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלְכֽוּ־ אֱ֠לֹהִים לִפְדּֽוֹת־ ל֨וֹ לְעָ֜ם וְלָשׂ֧וּם ל֣וֹ שֵׁ֗ם וְלַעֲשׂ֨וֹת לָכֶ֜ם הַגְּדוּלָּ֤ה וְנֹֽרָאוֹת֙ לְאַרְצֶ֔ךָ מִפְּנֵ֣י עַמְּךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּדִ֤יתָ לְּךָ֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם גּוֹיִ֖ם וֵאלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mî ḵə·‘am·mə·ḵā kə·yiś·rā·’êl gō·w ’e·ḥāḏ bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer hā·lə·ḵū- ’ĕ·lō·hîm lip̄·dō·wṯ- lōw lə·‘ām wə·lā·śūm lōw šêm wə·la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lā·ḵem hag·gə·ḏūl·lāh wə·nō·rā·’ō·wṯ lə·’ar·ṣe·ḵā mip·pə·nê ‘am·mə·ḵā ’ă·šer pā·ḏî·ṯā lə·ḵā mim·miṣ·ra·yim gō·w·yim wê·lō·hāw
verses.literal: And who is like Your people Israel the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself and to make a name for Himself You performed . . . great and awesome wonders by driving out nations and their gods from before Your people whom You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt
verses.literalPt: Quem há como o teu povo, como Israel, gente única na terra, a quem tu, ó Deus, foste resgatar para te ser povo, e fazer-te nome, e obrar a seu favor grandes coisas e coisas terríveis para a tua terra, diante do teu povo, que remiste para ti do Egito dentre as nações e os seus deuses.

verses.original: וַתְּכ֣וֹנֵֽן לְ֠ךָ אֶת־ עַמְּךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל׀ לְךָ֛ לְעָ֖ם עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם וְאַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ḵō·w·nên lə·ḵā ’eṯ- ‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḵā lə·‘ām ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām wə·’at·tāh Yah·weh hā·yî·ṯā lā·hem lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For You have established . . . Your people Israel as Your very own forever . . . and You O LORD have become their God
verses.literalPt: Estabeleceste o teu povo de Israel para ser o teu povo para sempre, e tu, Jeová, te fizeste o seu Deus.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ עַֽל־ עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַל־ בֵּית֔וֹ הָקֵ֖ם עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·bar·tā ‘al- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā wə·‘al- bê·ṯōw hā·qêm ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām wa·‘ă·śêh ka·’ă·šer dib·bar·tā
verses.literal: And now O LORD God confirm forever . . . the word You have spoken concerning Your servant . . . and his house Do as You have promised
verses.literalPt: Agora, Deus Jeová, quanto à palavra que falaste acerca do teu servo e acerca da sua casa, confirma-a para sempre e faze como tens falado.

verses.original: וְיִגְדַּ֨ל שִׁמְךָ֤ עַד־ עוֹלָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֱלֹהִ֖ים עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבֵית֙ עַבְדְּךָ֣ דָוִ֔ד יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiḡ·dal šim·ḵā ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām lê·mōr Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇêṯ ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ḏā·wiḏ yih·yeh nā·ḵō·wn lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: so that Your name will be magnified forever . . . when it is said The LORD of Hosts is God over Israel And the house of Your servant David will be established before You
verses.literalPt: Seja o teu nome engrandecido para sempre, e se diga: Jeová dos Exércitos é Deus sobre Israel. A casa do teu servo Davi será estabelecida diante de ti.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּה֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּלִ֜יתָה אֶת־ אֹ֤זֶן עַבְדְּךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בַּ֖יִת אֶבְנֶה־ לָּ֑ךְ עַל־ כֵּ֗ן מָצָ֤א עַבְדְּךָ֙ אֶת־ לִבּ֔וֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלֶ֔יךָ אֶת־ הַתְּפִלָּ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl gā·lî·ṯāh ’eṯ- ’ō·zen ‘aḇ·də·ḵā lê·mōr ba·yiṯ ’eḇ·neh- lāḵ ‘al- kên mā·ṣā ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ’eṯ- lib·bōw lə·hiṯ·pal·lêl ’ê·le·ḵā ’eṯ- hat·tə·p̄il·lāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: For You O LORD of Hosts the God of Israel have revealed this - to Your servant when You said I will build a house for you Therefore . . . Your servant has found the courage to offer this prayer to You
verses.literalPt: Pois tu, Jeová dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel, deste uma revelação ao teu servo, dizendo: Edificar-te-ei uma casa. Por isso, teu servo se animou para te fazer esta oração.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אַתָּה־ הוּא֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּדְבָרֶ֖יךָ יִהְי֣וּ אֱמֶ֑ת וַתְּדַבֵּר֙ אֶֽל־ עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶת־ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’at·tāh- hū hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḏə·ḇā·re·ḵā yih·yū ’ĕ·meṯ wat·tə·ḏab·bêr ’el- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ’eṯ- haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: And now O Lord GOD You are God Your words are true and You have promised this goodness to Your servant
verses.literalPt: Agora, Senhor Jeová, tu és Deus, e as tuas palavras são verdade, e tens prometido ao teu servo esse bem.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹאֵל֙ וּבָרֵךְ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִהְי֥וֹת לְעוֹלָ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֞ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתָּ וּמִבִּרְכָ֣תְךָ֔ יְבֹרַ֥ךְ בֵּֽית־ עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְעוֹלָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hō·w·’êl ū·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- bêṯ ‘aḇ·də·ḵā lih·yō·wṯ lə·‘ō·w·lām lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kî- ’at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh dib·bar·tā ū·mib·bir·ḵā·ṯə·ḵā yə·ḇō·raḵ bêṯ- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Now therefore may it please You to bless the house of Your servant that it may continue forever before You For You O Lord GOD have spoken and with Your blessing the house of Your servant will be blessed forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Sejas, agora, servido de abençoar a casa do teu servo, para que subsista para sempre diante de ti. Pois tu, Senhor Jeová, o falaste; e, com a tua bênção, seja para sempre abençoada a casa do teu servo.
